questions.questionText: Which country will Sara’s group present?
questions.content: Two students are discussing a school exhibition. “Our group will present Egypt,” says Sara. “We will show a picture of the Pyramids of Giza and explain that Cairo is Egypt’s capital.” Tom replies, “Our group will present France. We will talk about Paris and the Eiffel Tower.”
